title: qPCR Primer Design
author: Steven J Burgess
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.br4hm8t6
materials: Navigate to NCBI Primer-BLAST in your browser

Open the software UNAfold in a new tab on your browser to test for secondary structure formation by the amplicon sequence to be amplified by primers. Ideally, your primers should pass this QC as well, but in the event, it is not possible to find a pair that passes both the primer and amplicon QC it is worth progressing to test experimentally.

steps.title: Select and Prepare Gene Sequence
steps.instruction: Identify the gene of interest and obtain the transcript sequence in .gb format from a public database (e.g., NCBI or Phytozome) and upload it to Benchling.

substeps.instruction: If quantifying total gene expression rather than specific splice forms, align known splice form sequences using Clustal Omega and retain only the common regions.

steps.title: Design Primers using Primer-BLAST
steps.instruction: Use Primer-BLAST to design primers based on the transcript sequence with specific parameters.

substeps.instruction: Enter the species name (e.g., Solanum tuberosum) under the organism tab.
Paste the transcript sequence and click 'Get Primers'.
Select primers with a single perfect match using BLAST.
Record the forward primer sequence, reverse primer sequence, and amplicon size in a table.

steps.title: Configure OligoAnalyzer for QC
steps.instruction: Open IDT's OligoAnalyzer Tool and set the parameters for qPCR analysis.

substeps.instruction: Adjust concentrations to: [Oligo] = 0.33 nM, [Na+] = 50 mM, [Mg 2+] = 3 mM, and [dNTP] = 1.2 mM.

steps.title: Perform Primer Quality Control
steps.instruction: Analyze the primer sequences for hairpins and dimers to ensure they meet quality thresholds.

substeps.instruction: Enter the first primer sequence and analyze hairpin formation; record the highest Tm (must be lower than the annealing temperature, e.g., < 60 °C).
Analyze self-dimer free energy; record the lowest dG (must be > -9 kcal/mol).
Analyze heterodimer free energy by entering the reverse primer as a secondary sequence; record the lowest dG (must be > -9 kcal/mol).
Repeat these checks for the reverse primer.
If any primer fails these checks, return to Primer-BLAST and select a different pair.

steps.title: Analyze Amplicon Structure via UNAfold
steps.instruction: Evaluate the predicted structures of the assay amplicon using UNAfold.

substeps.instruction: Set the Mg++ concentration to 3 mM.
Inspect predicted structures; ensure the highest Tm for any predicted structure is less than the primer annealing temperature (e.g., < 60 °C).
